[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=The Floodplain of Mahnkelon | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=384 }} [[The Floodplain of Mahnkelon]] is a fertile piece of lowlands that is fed and constantly renewed by the seasonal flooding of the [[Elon]] river. The Kournans who stay in this region are housed in camps and outposts on higher ground that double up as shelter during rainy seasons. ==Getting there== This area lies to the northeast of the [[Kodonur Crossroads (outpost)|Kodonur Crossroads]] [[mission outpost]]. Your character's choice of either [[Margrid the Sly]] or the [[Master of Whispers]] determines whether this area is optional or not. Characters who chose to follow Margrid will not need to come here as completion of the [[Pogahn Passage]] mission will completely bypass this area. Those with Master of Whispers will end up here as part of the [[primary quest]] [[To Kill a Demon]]. ==Exits== *[[Jahai Bluffs]] (west) *[[Kodonur Crossroads (outpost)|Kodonur Crossroads]] (southwest)
